spec_match.rationale: One get() call with mediation 'conditional', uiMode 'passive' and optional password:true, alongside an autocomplete="username webauthn" field — the composition in the explainer's API section and the spec PR's 'either of the above prompts' step.

interactive.rationale: Two composition toggles with live call preview, Arm/Cancel, a real sign-in form whose submit aborts the pending request; results branch on cred.type.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises toggles, arm/cancel, typed-password abort and type branching; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Which surface settled the promise is not exposed by the API; the page reports focus location as a labelled heuristic. PasswordCredential results could not be exercised headless.

conformance.rationale: Observation route for the passive-and-autofill-share-one-request manual assertion.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts capability branch, resolved (challenge match or password type), ended reasons and the password path.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend, visible labels, aria-describedby hint, role=status verdict; focus moves to Cancel on arm and back to Arm on settle/cancel.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5068149209825280, the explainer and spec PR w3c/webauthn#2485.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, in four configurations: default, --enable-features=WebAuthenticationAmbientSignin (+ CDP virtual authenticator), --enable-blink-features=WebAuthenticationAmbient, --enable-experimental-web-platform-features. Zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow, no sub-44px targets; screenshots read. Flag + virtual authenticator: armed on load, resolved with a real public-key credential; re-armed with password:true and no uiMode; typed-password submit took the password path. Default: rejected NotSupportedError headless, reported.

design_system.rationale: Shared ambient.css uses only public/styles.css variables; every button override sets both background and color; verdict colours are emerald-dark/rose on stone (AA).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with identical outcomes; 0px overflow; single-column at 360px. The underlying feature is a desktop prototype (origin_trial_os win/mac/linux/chromeos); on Android the page reports the capability honestly as not reported rather than hiding controls.

openQuestions.title: Verify the autofill half under the flag in headed Chrome
openQuestions.detail: Confirm that after ignoring the passive suggestion, focusing the webauthn field offers the same credentials and that picking one settles the same promise.

guidanceConsulted.query: sign-in form autocomplete username webauthn current-password
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use autocomplete="username webauthn" and "current-password", visible labels, no autofocus on forms embedded in a larger page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied exactly; no autofocus because the form is embedded in an explainer page; aria-describedby links the hint.

guidanceConsulted.query: passkey sign-in conditional mediation webauthn autofill
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect with getClientCapabilities() before conditional get; pass an AbortController signal; segregate NotAllowedError/AbortError; abort pending conditional requests before an explicit prompt.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Capability read gates the auto-start; every request carries a signal with an Abort control; error names are branched explicitly. Exception: no server, so challenges are client-generated and the signature is not verified — stated on the page.

guidanceConsulted.query: non-modal sign-in prompt passkey feature detection getClientCapabilities
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never infer support from browser name/version or from an accepted option; read the capability key at runtime; unknown dictionary keys are ignored.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Support is read from conditionalPassiveGet/ambientGet only; the page explains that an accepted uiMode value proves nothing.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous state changes in a polite status region; keep focus on a surviving control when controls disable/hide.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts use role=status; focus is restored to the originating control when a disabled/hidden control would drop it to body.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column stages on narrow screens, wrap long monospace strings, 44px targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Meters collapse to one column under 640px; overflow-wrap:anywhere on outputs; measured 0px overflow at 360px and all buttons/inputs >=44px.

summary: One request, two surfaces: the composition the spec PR preserves, with clean cancellation when the user types a password instead.
